paite: TOUPA, hon panpih in; Pathian limsakmi lah a-om nawnta ngal kei ua; mihing tate lak a kipan miginom lah amangta ngal ua.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La: Sheminith A Sak Ding / Panpihna Dia Thumna

paite: Michih in a-invengte kiang ah thu bangmah lou maimai agengen ua; maitang phatna leh khemna lungtang pu in thu agen nak uhi.
TOUPA'N maitang phatna muk tengteng a-atkhe ding a, thu kisathei genna lei toh,
amau, i lei in i zou ding ua; i mukte eimah a ngei aka, kua ahia i tung a lal om? achi uhi.
TOUPA'N, "Gentheite asimmoh ziak uleh, tagahte thum ziak in, ka thou pah dia; anuihsan uh bittak in ka omsak ding," achi hi.
TOUPA thute thu siangthoutak ahi a; dangka leitung a haltuina mei a etkhiak a, sagihvei hihsiangthou zohsa bang ahi.
TOUPA aw, nang amau na kemhoih ding a, hiai khangte lak ah chik lai peuh in leng na humbit ding.
Mihing tate lak ah khelhna pahtawi a a-om in, migilou-salou avialvak nak uhi.
